title: Columbus tech founder sells majority stake in software firm to private equity group
snippet: The founder of a Columbus-based software company sold a majority stake to a Chicago private equity firm in a deal that closed this month, marking a liquidity event for the founding family.

title: Central Ohio manufacturer names new CEO as longtime chief retires
snippet: A Central Ohio manufacturing company announced its longtime chief executive officer will retire at year end, with the chief operating officer named as successor.

title: Dublin, Ohio logistics startup to acquire regional competitor
snippet: A logistics company headquartered in Dublin, Ohio has entered a definitive agreement to acquire a smaller regional competitor, expanding its footprint across the Midwest.

title: New Albany, Ohio lands new corporate headquarters as firm relocates from Chicago
snippet: A national insurance firm announced plans to relocate its headquarters to New Albany, Ohio, bringing several hundred jobs and its executive leadership team to the region.
